scenarios.name: Vision ready
scenarios.description: Vision model selected; prompt composer and image attachment available.

scenarios.name: ASR ready
scenarios.description: Audio mode selected; WAV/MP3 upload and registered Whisper ASR selector visible.

scenarios.name: No ASR model registered
scenarios.description: Audio upload is visible with an empty ASR selector and registration guidance.

scenarios.name: Model lacks image capability
scenarios.description: Text model selected; image control hidden and capability guidance visible.

scenarios.name: Upload exceeds limit
scenarios.description: Selected image exceeds the proposed 10 MB limit; persistent validation alert appears.

scenarios.name: Multimodal inference rejected
scenarios.description: Image attached; persistent error explains the selected model rejected multimodal input.

scenarios.name: Conversation already has a file
scenarios.description: Transcript contains one attached image; image and audio controls are disabled with the one-file limit explained.

scenarios.name: Assets with ASR model
scenarios.description: AI Asset table contains Whisper marked as an ASR transcription endpoint.

scenarios.name: No AI Assets registered
scenarios.description: Empty table explains that an endpoint must be registered before Playground audio can use it.

scenarios.name: No ASR capability marked
scenarios.description: AI Assets exist, but none is marked as a transcription endpoint.

scenarios.name: Asset list failed to load
scenarios.description: Persistent error alert appears above the AI Asset table with a retry action.
